Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta i iliotibijalnog traktusa.
Kompleksna ruptura trupa medijalnog meniska, čija se horizontalna komponenta koja doseže
donju artikulacijsku plohu pruža u stražnji rog meniska. U području stražnjeg roga komunicira sa
slobodnim rubom meniska, gdje se nalazi parameniscealna cista duž stražnjeg aspekta stražnjeg
roga medijalnog meniska promjera do 2 mm.
Korpus medijalnog meniska periferno je potisnut izvan zglobne pukotine.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Entezofitoza pri inserciji tetiva m. kvadricepsa i ligamenta patele. U distalnom dijelu lig. patele
nalazi se ukopano koštano tijelo dimenzija 12x6 mm - stanje po Osgood-Schlaterovoj bolesti.
Plitke fisure i defekti hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura i tibije te lateralne fasete patele
(hondromalacija 2. stupnja prema ICRS klasifikaciji).
Fisure i raslojavanje pune debljine hrskavice lateralnog kondila tibije (hondromalacija 3. stupnja
prema ICRS klasifikaciji).
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Manja količina izljeva u koljenu, manja poplitealna (Bakerova) cista.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: lumbar radiculopathy; bilateral knee pain for 1 year, no injury
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild thinning without focal defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the posterior weightbearing lateral tibial plateau. Cartilage thinning along the lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild heterogeneity with low-grade fissuring of the medial facet and median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt and translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tricompartmental chondrosis, most significant in the lateral compartment.
2.	Small knee joint effusion.

There is medial meniscal extrusion at the level of the body, deemed secondary to an undisplaced degenerative type tear through the corresponding posterior horn and root.  
Mildly degenerate but otherwise intact lateral meniscus, normal cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, patellar tendon and distal iliotibial band. Chronic, quiescent looking calcific distal insertional quadriceps tendinopathy is present anteriorly. 
 No fracture or marrow infiltration, minimal intra-articular fluid, probably within normal physiological limits.  Mild age-related thinning of tricompartmental articular cartilage, probably most apparent at the medial weightbearing compartment. Tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss with associated faint focal reactive marrow changes is noted adjacent to the median ridge of the patella.  Small focus of grade 3 cartilage loss noted at the central portion of the lateral tibial plateau. Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Indication: [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:

Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tear of the medial meniscus body extending into the body-posterior horn junction with mild extrusion.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Légère chondropatie fémoropatellaire et médiale sans fissuration profonde.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Légers changements mucoïdes sans signe de déchirure.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : Normal.

MRI RIGHT KNEE  (plain)

Clinical information:
Right knee instability. Anterior drawer test positive? Anterior cruciate ligament injury.

Technique: 
Multiplanar MR of the knee according to protocol.

Comparison: 
None

Findings: 

Menisci

Lateral meniscus: intact

Medial meniscus: Mild hyperintensity is seen at the posterior horn suggestive of intrasubstance degeneration. No definite tear. No parameniscal cyst. 

Ligaments

Anterior cruciate ligament: Intact fibers are present however caliber of these fibers is somewhat attenuated compatible with a remote low-grade partial thickness injury. No significant tibial translation.

Posterior cruciate ligament: intact 

Medial collateral ligament: Superficial and deep components intact. No periligamentous edema.

Lateral collateral ligament: The iliotibial band, biceps femoris tendon, fibular collateral ligament and popliteus muscle and tendon intact. 

Posterolateral corner structures: Intact

Extensor Mechanism

The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. The patella is normally positioned within the femoral groove. There is no retinacular disruption.

Fluid

No joint effusion or loose body. No Baker's cyst.

Osseous and Articular Structures

Bones: No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.

Patellofemoral compartment: Marked patella chondral hypertrophy is seen measuring up to 1.0 cm in thickness at the patella apex. It appears heterogeneously hyperintense with regions of hypointensity, possibly due to mineralization. No evidence of invasion into the patella bone. It is closely abutting a medial plica. A possible loose body is also seen. Suspicious fissure also observed at the apex. Findings non specific in nature but favours to represent severe chondromalacia. Differential diagnoses such as focal synovitis and PVNS are less probable. 

Medial compartment: Mild chondrosis of the medial femoral condyle.

Lateral compartment: Mild chondrosis of the lateral femoral condyle.

Others:

Hoffas fat pad: clear

Muscles: No abnormal oedema. 

Neurovascular bundle: Normal 


COMMENT
Low grade, remote, partial thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. No tibial translation.

Marked heterogeneous hypertrophy of the articular cartilage of the patella measuring up to 1.0 cm in thickness at the patella apex. Signal in this irregular thickened cartilage is heterogeneously hyperintense on T2-weighted imaging and shows focal regions of hypointensity which may represent mineralization. Findings are favored to represent severe chondropathic change involving the articular cartilage of the patella.

There is a mild knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  ACL is ruptured in its mid substance. There is mild residual bone contusion in the weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and posterior aspect of the lateral tibial condyle. Mild anterior translation of the lateral tibial plateau is seen in relation to femur.  Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Normal visualized remaining bones and surrounding soft tissues.  Conclusion: ACL rupture.

МР находка: МР данни за контузионен костномозъчен едем в кондилите на фемура и тибията. Отокът в тибията е локализиран предимно срединно под интеркондиларните еминенции. Ставният хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. МР данни за руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Последната е едемна, с уголемен напречник. Виждат се едемни изменения и висок сигнален интензитет в проксималното залавно място на латералния колатерален лигамент. Последният е със запазен континуитет и лекостепенно нагънат ход. Дегенеративни промени в заден рог на медиалния менискус. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Визуализира се перисиновиална киста на нивото на медиалната глава на м. гастрокнемиус. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – без особености. Наличие на ставен излив. Заключение:  МР данни за руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Контузионен костномозъчен едем във фемура и тибията. Частична увреда на латералния колатерален лигамент. Ставен излив.
